Finansman belirsizliği azalırken mevcut hissedarların payı seyreldi. • Mevcut faaliyetler: Sipariş birikimi 2,36 milyar dolara ulaştı. OPENAI SAYS KIMI-LINKED USERS TRIED TO DISTILL ITS MODELS OpenAI says it disrupted a coordinated campaign aimed at extracting protected reasoning from its models, with a core cluster linked to individuals associated with Moonshot AI, the developer of Kimi. The activity began July 1 and spiked to around 16,000 extraction attempts across 4,000+ users on July 24-25. OpenAI later identified related activity across a broader cluster of more than 15,000 users. One method involved taking encrypted reasoning from one conversation and asking another model to decrypt and reproduce it. OpenAI says there was no breach of its databases, encryption or stored user conversations. The company banned or restricted accounts, closed the extraction pathway and shared its findings with industry and government partners. OpenAI says the figures represent attempted extractions, not necessarily successful ones.
